subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers land the public gateway ReDoS fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102411, or route the report through private security handling first?
rationale: The code repair is narrow and well-proven, but the failure mode is a crafted-input event-loop stall on a stable gateway reply path, so automation should not choose the security handling boundary by itself.

options.title: Land after security-aware review
options.body: Proceed with the focused parser fix once a gateway/security owner accepts the validation semantics and public handling path.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Pause the public PR path and handle the denial-of-service report through the repository security process if coordinated handling is preferred.

recommendation.title: Land after security-aware review
recommendation.body: Proceed with the focused parser fix once a gateway/security owner accepts the validation semantics and public handling path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the managed outgoing image feature and later managed-image hardening in the same module.
